title: Customer wants to change date or address
summary: Reschedule or redirect an existing job.

n1.q: Has an agent already accepted the job?

end: Change the date or address on the Admin portal.
Date change: update the Moveover file.
Shopee reschedule ≥1 day: log in Move-over sheet; counts as a first attempt.
Address: change only with the agent's agreement.
Shopee already accepted: not rescheduled — advise the seller to decline the buyer's request.
TikTok / SGH / medical jobs are never moved.
